lines.en: Please help me wash the vegetables.
Sure, Grandma. What are these?
They are carrots, onions, and potatoes.
Can I eat a raw carrot?
Yes, raw carrots are good for you.
Last time you boiled the beans. It was fun.
Today I will boil corn and cabbage.
Do we need tomatoes?
Yes. Cut this tomato, please. Be careful.
lines.ko: 네. 이 토마토를 잘라 주세요. 조심하세요.

lines.en: Here it is. I love cooking with you, Grandma.
lines.ko: 여기 있어요. 할머니랑 요리하는 게 좋아요.

lines.en: Excuse me. How do you cook this cabbage?
I boil it with a little salt.
Do you boil the corn too?
Yes, boil the corn for ten minutes.
lines.ko: 네, 옥수수는 십 분 동안 삶으세요.

lines.en: Yesterday I boiled potatoes too long.
Oh, that's easy. Boil them ten minutes only.
lines.ko: 아, 그건 쉬워요. 딱 십 분만 삶으세요.

lines.en: And the beans? Can I eat them raw?
No, please boil beans. Raw beans are not good.
lines.ko: 아니요, 콩은 삶으세요. 날콩은 안 좋아요.

lines.en: Thank you. I will try it tonight.
You are welcome. Put onions and carrots in too.
